command:
sh -c 'set +e
base=/data/brewing-assistant
active=$1
expected=$2
active_session=$3
clean(){ printf "%s" "$1" | tr "\n|" "  "; }
for dir in state templates sessions reports template-backups ha-public; do mkdir -p "$base/$dir" 2>/dev/null || true; done
probe_dir(){
  key=$1; dir=$2; token=rc3-$key-$$; probe=$dir/.system-check-$key-$$
  if [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then printf "DIR|%s|missing|%s|Katalogen finnes ikke og kunne ikke opprettes\n" "$key" "$dir"; return; fi
  result=$( (umask 077; printf "%s" "$token" > "$probe" && readback=$(cat "$probe") && [ "$readback" = "$token" ] && rm -f "$probe" && [ ! -e "$probe" ]) 2>&1 ); code=$?
  if [ "$code" -eq 0 ]; then printf "DIR|%s|ok|%s|Kontrollfil skrevet, lest og slettet\n" "$key" "$dir"; else rm -f "$probe" 2>/dev/null; printf "DIR|%s|probe_failed|%s|%s\n" "$key" "$dir" "$(clean "$result")"; fi
}
for dir in state templates sessions reports template-backups ha-public; do probe_dir "$dir" "$base/$dir"; done
pointer=$base/state/current_state.json
if [ ! -e "$pointer" ]; then printf "POINTER|missing||Filen finnes ikke\n"; else
  detail=$(node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");try{const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],\"utf8\"));if(!p||Object.keys(p).length!==1||!/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/.test(String(p.active_session||\"\")))throw new Error(\"må inneholde kun gyldig active_session\");process.stdout.write(String(p.active_session))}catch(e){console.error(e.message);process.exit(2)}" "$pointer" 2>&1); code=$?
  if [ "$code" -eq 0 ]; then printf "POINTER|valid|%s|Gyldig aktiv sesjonspeker\n" "$(clean "$detail")"; else printf "POINTER|corrupt||%s\n" "$(clean "$detail")"; fi
fi
if [ -n "$active" ] && [ -r "$base/templates/$active" ]; then actual=$(sha256sum "$base/templates/$active" 2>/dev/null|sed "s/[[:space:]].*//");size=$(stat -c %s "$base/templates/$active" 2>/dev/null||echo 0);mtime=$(stat -c %Y "$base/templates/$active" 2>/dev/null||echo 0);if [ -z "$actual" ];then ts=hash_error;elif [ -n "$expected" ]&&[ "$actual" != "$expected" ];then ts=changed;else ts=ok;fi;printf "TEMPLATE|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s\n" "$active" "$ts" "$actual" "$expected" "$size" "$mtime";else printf "TEMPLATE|%s|missing||%s|0|0\n" "$active" "$expected";fi
disk_line(){ key=$1;path=$2;set -- $(df -Pk "$path" 2>/dev/null|awk "NR==2{gsub(/%/,\"\",\$5);print \$2,\$4,\$5,\$6}");printf "DISK|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s\n" "$key" "${1:-0}" "${2:-0}" "${3:-100}" "${4:-ukjent}"; }
disk_line data "$base"
for f in "$base/reports"/*.html;do [ -f "$f" ]||continue;printf "REPORT|%s|%s|%s|%s\n" "${f##*/}" "$(stat -c %s "$f" 2>/dev/null||echo 0)" "$(stat -c %Y "$f" 2>/dev/null||echo 0)" "$(sha256sum "$f" 2>/dev/null|sed "s/[[:space:]].*//")";done
public=$base/ha-public/siste-bryggerapport.html;if [ -r "$public" ];then printf "PUBLIC|ok|%s|%s|%s\n" "$(stat -c %s "$public" 2>/dev/null||echo 0)" "$(stat -c %Y "$public" 2>/dev/null||echo 0)" "$(sha256sum "$public" 2>/dev/null|sed "s/[[:space:]].*//")";else printf "PUBLIC|missing|0|0|\n";fi
public_historical=$base/ha-public/siste-historiske-bryggerapport.html;if [ -r "$public_historical" ];then printf "PUBLIC_HISTORICAL|ok|%s|%s|%s\n" "$(stat -c %s "$public_historical" 2>/dev/null||echo 0)" "$(stat -c %Y "$public_historical" 2>/dev/null||echo 0)" "$(sha256sum "$public_historical" 2>/dev/null|sed "s/[[:space:]].*//")";else printf "PUBLIC_HISTORICAL|missing|0|0|\n";fi
for f in "$base/sessions"/*.jsonl;do [ -f "$f" ]||continue;n=${f##*/};started=no;lastvalid=no;outcome=unfinished
  grep -Eq "\"event\":\"brewday_started\"" "$f" 2>/dev/null&&started=yes
  if grep -Eq "\"event\":\"emergency_end_requested\"" "$f" 2>/dev/null;then outcome=emergency;elif grep -Eq "\"event\":\"brewday_completed\"" "$f" 2>/dev/null;then outcome=completed;elif grep -Eq "\"event\":\"brewday_ended\"" "$f" 2>/dev/null;then outcome=ended;fi
  tail -n 1 "$f" 2>/dev/null|node -e "let s=\"\";process.stdin.on(\"data\",d=>s+=d).on(\"end\",()=>{try{JSON.parse(s);process.exit(0)}catch(e){process.exit(1)}})" >/dev/null 2>&1&&lastvalid=yes
  printf "SESSION|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s\n" "$n" "$(stat -c %s "$f" 2>/dev/null||echo 0)" "$(stat -c %Y "$f" 2>/dev/null||echo 0)" "$outcome" "$started" "$lastvalid"
done
printf "VERSION|node|%s\n" "$(node -p "process.version" 2>/dev/null||echo ukjent)";printf "VERSION|node_red|%s\n" "$(node -e "try{process.stdout.write(require(\"node-red/package.json\").version)}catch(e){process.stdout.write(\"ukjent\")}" 2>/dev/null)";printf "VERSION|ha_nodes|%s\n" "$(node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");for(const p of [\"/data/node_modules/node-red-contrib-home-assistant-websocket/package.json\",\"/usr/src/node-red/node_modules/node-red-contrib-home-assistant-websocket/package.json\"]){try{process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\")).version);process.exit(0)}catch(e){}}process.stdout.write(\"ukjent\")" 2>/dev/null)"
' sh
